title: Pan-Seared Thai Fish with Paong Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from the Chinese cuisine, featuring pan-seared fish and a rich Paong sauce.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Season the fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
3. Pan-sear the fish fillets for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
4. In a blender, combine Paong, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
5. Blend the mixture until smooth to make the Paong sauce.
6. Stir the Paong sauce into the pan with the fish fillets.
7. Simmer the sauce for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
8. Serve the pan-seared fish with the rich Paong sauce.
9. Garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
